column1: # compile-pass rows (area compile-pass) for rust-v0.167.0: fixes made by the compile pass (PF-85-S02/S04) in files other slices resolved, plus what it leaves open; kept in their own file to stay clear of the 512,000-byte blob limit; same columns

column17: note

compile pass: main's Refused end event (43bfa16dee) uses upstream's four-field ExecCommandResult (aggregated_output carries the refusal text); main's #442/#826 explain_protected_read now matches upstream's `UnifiedExec` emitter instead of the removed `Shell` one (compile only, see the open row)

compile pass found: `ToolEmitter::finish` (which adds main's #442 protected-read and #826 user-namespace explanations) is called only by apply_patch on the sync branch; unified exec ends commands without it, so neither explanation reaches the person or model for a denied command. S3b must wire it into unified exec's end path (main had it on the shell handler). Explanation only; no permission decision depends on it

compile pass: main's #1701 own-agent check goes through `local_or_unsupported()` (upstream's AgentControl trait object); any other backend treats every target as foreign (fail closed), as multi_agents_common::ensure_own_agent does

compile pass: PF-84-S03's level-in-force check reads the policy through `local_or_unsupported()`; another backend or an unreadable policy counts as Aggressive (fail closed, as before); the approval-off test uses upstream's `TurnContext::approval_policy()`
compile pass: upstream's `SessionServices::auth_manager()` accessor

compile pass test run (glitch, 2026-11-14): codex-guardian-v2 lib tests 85 passed, 40 failed; every failure panics at extension_tests.rs:974 'reviewer model should have Guardian policy': the sync catalog's codex-auto-review row has no model_messages.auto_review/approvals/permissions (main removed them; S1b's JSON merge kept main's value). Needs a decision: restore upstream's auto_review policy for codex-auto-review, or point these tests at a fixture model

compile pass: main tests dropped from session/tests.rs because they drive APIs upstream removed; port them onto upstream's turn_input::handle (StartOrSteer/Steer), StepSettingsUpdate and the input-queue admission API. PF-83 steering authority (23915e5c6f, 44bbf0db17, main #2073): steer_input_rejects_changed_authorization_without_mutating_active_work, steer_input_accepts_unchanged_authorization_after_settings_update, steer_input_accepts_runtime_user_layer_reload, authorization_changed_defer_race_starts_fresh_turn_without_error, authorization_changed_mail_waits_for_turn_boundary, authorization_changed_injection_preserves_items_until_completion, authorization_changed_public_injection_waits_for_later_model_turn, authorization_changed_natural_completion_preserves_model_output_schema (+ helper assert_authorization_changed_model_admission), authorization_changed_user_input_runs_after_completion_with_latest_permissions, authorization_changed_deferred_input_survives_interrupt, authorization_changed_interrupted_input_wakes_fresh_admission, authorization_changed_turn_receives_code_mode_notify_and_user_shell_output, interrupted_input_cannot_be_spliced_into_review_task, deferred_input_does_not_interrupt_turn_local_sleep, deferred_mail_does_not_interrupt_turn_local_sleep, running_turn_notes_the_mail_it_takes (#2073); steering/defer (main): task_finish_submits_follow_up_when_active_turn_was_replaced, non_steerable_turn_defers_user_input_until_completion, non_steerable_defer_race_starts_fresh_turn_without_error, interrupt_clears_steered_input_without_follow_up_turn; PF-13 (3db1c68755): user_turn_updates_approvals_reviewer's check that the user-turn path publishes refreshed MCP state before execution (upstream deleted the test with Op::UserInput). Also not ported: upstream's image-rule assertion in task_finish_emits_turn_item_lifecycle_for_leftover_pending_user_input (main's follow-up-turn version kept, as the sync code starts a follow-up turn). Carries S2a's open test contract from #2064: (1) only workspace roots/primary environment roots change during a turn -> a steer and agent mail are deferred (TurnAuthority); (2) prefer_mxc + Elevated under Moderate/Aggressive -> file_system_sandbox_context carries the D491 refusal; (3) a profile change keeps the PF-33/PF-27-S02 settings (#2043) | sync-compile2 (#2271): ported steer_input_rejects_changed_authorization_without_mutating_active_work and steer_input_accepts_unchanged_authorization_after_settings_update onto upstream's turn_input::handle (TurnInputMode::Steer -> NotSubmitted{AuthorizationChanged} / Steered) in session/turn_input_tests.rs (they type-check; not run yet: the lib tests don't compile). The 20 others and the PF-13 refresh check remain open; main's user-visible refusal text is not asserted (upstream reports AuthorizationChanged through handlers.rs/tasks).
